# Multiple instance learning for depression detection in interviews

- Autores: Ana Pérez, Luis Gómez
- Año: 2025
- Venue: Scientific Reports
- Cuartil: Q1
- DOI/URL: https://doi.org/10.1000/fixture.1
- Clave: perez2025_mil

## Verificación
- Herramienta: semanticscholar (batch_get_papers)

## Abstract

Clinical interviews are a common source for automatic depression detection.
Previous studies used only selected answers, which loses information.
We apply a multiple instance learning framework to full interview transcripts.
Each instance is encoded independently and an ensemble aggregates the scores.
The F1 score is 0.88 on DAIC-WOZ. Instance-level evidence makes the model interpretable.
